summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Skyworks Solutions, Inc. reporting quarterly financial results for the period ended April 3, 2026, and declaring a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.71 per share. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is present. The filing merely satisfies disclosure obligations under Items 2.02 and 8.01. Accordingly, it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
